name: Canvas
summary: The agent works on a shared visual surface, such as a whiteboard, document or design, next to the chat. It reads the current state of the canvas, including the user's selection and viewport, and edits it through actions like creating, moving or deleting shapes, so user and agent work on the same object.
how: Give the agent a view of the canvas: selection, viewport, simplified shapes or a screenshot
Expose canvas edits as agent actions
Apply actions live so the user sees changes as they happen
Let the user edit by hand and keep the agent's view in sync
facts: tldraw agent starter kit, Claude Design
Strong for visual work, but complex state to sync
watchOut: Large canvases exceed context; needs summarising
Concurrent human and agent edits can conflict
